verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a full webhooks system: HTTPS POST callbacks to merchant-registered endpoints, up to 10 subscribable URLs per app scoped to specific event types, durable delivery with retries, and signature verification for authenticity — directly matching the 'subscribe to events via webhooks' story. This is a core PayPal API capability that agent-commerce flows (orders, carts, disputes) run on top of. Missing for 10: no explicit example tying webhook subscription specifically to agentic/AI-initiated events or agent-toolkit code subscribing to webhooks, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
